### S2 Sign in

Sign in to the portal before filing a claim, from **“Sign in”**.

1. Type your email in **“you@example.com”**.
2. Type your password in **“Password”** and press **“Continue”**.

> If you see **“The email or the password is not right.”**, check the email and the password and try again.
